auditor_value: Assertion false (a constant acceleration with an initial velocity not along it gives a parabola whatever axes are used), Reason true

findings.quote: but a true Reason cannot rescue the false Assertion
findings.note: 'rescue' is a metaphor; the brief asks for literal textbook English.
findings.fix: but a true Reason does not make a false Assertion true

question_defect: Assertion-reason item served with an empty options list; the solution's option numbers assume the standard scheme the student does not see.
notes: Independent reading agrees: the path of a particle under constant acceleration is a parabola (or a straight line if the velocity is along the acceleration) independent of the axes chosen, so the Assertion's 'can never' is false; the Reason is the standard true statement. Option 4 under the standard scheme. The two mistake entries both describe accepting the Assertion, which is the genuine error here.
